title_avd: Tapo C200 的 RTSP 身份验证中经过身份验证的基于堆栈的缓冲区溢出(CVE-2026-1871)
description_raw: TP-Link Tapo C200 v5 contains a stack-based buffer overflow flaw in RTSP authentication handling due to improper validation of Authorization header field lengths, which can be triggered by a crafted authentication request.

condition.value: due to improper validation of Authorization header field lengths

provenance.trigger_requests_note: AVD 原文不含完整 RTSP request 序列
